summary: Loads the web-tree-sitter runtime and every grammar registered via makeParser (ensureParsersReady, serialised and idempotent), and hands each extractor a getParser() over a wrapper that accepts string or chunk-callback input and deletes the previous tree on each parse. resetParsers() (called after a parse-guard timeout) throws away the WHOLE runtime: drops the require-cache entry for web-tree-sitter, nulls runtime/runtimeSync and marks every grammar unloaded so getParser() throws until the next ensureParsersReady() reloads everything (~20ms). Fresh parsers on the same runtime are not enough: web-tree-sitter keeps one emscripten module per process, and a stop between wasmMemory.grow() and updateMemoryViews() leaves its closure-private heap views detached, so every later parse of every grammar fails with 'detached ArrayBuffer'. parsersReady() lets parseFile re-await the reload when another file's timeout straddled its await.
